關閉或最小化主視窗後，可從右下角 Speed Editor 圖示重新開啟。滑鼠控: After closing or minimizing the window, reopen it from the Speed Editor tray icon. Mouse controls, automatic templates and the floating panel keep running.
關閉程式，把 EXE 與 config.json 一起放到可寫入資料夾；不需要安: Close the app and copy the EXE and config.json to a writable folder. Python and the _internal folder are not required. Copying only the EXE creates fresh settings. Sign-in credentials stay on the computer, so sign in again on another computer.
關閉該配置層的智慧旋鈕即可恢復原有音量、亮度等旋鈕設定。切換程式時不會捨棄未儲存: Disable the smart button of the configuration to restore the original volume, brightness, etc. Switching does not discard unsaved editing; save or restore the image before following the device.
限支援播放清單的來源，例如 VLC。: Requires a source with playlist support, such as VLC.
雙擊右下角圖示可開啟主視窗；右鍵可結束程式。: Double-click the tray icon to open the window. Right-click to quit.
雙擊系統匣圖示：開啟主視窗。右鍵：顯示浮動面板、解除面板穿透或結束程式。若圖示被: Double-click the tray icon to open the window. Right-click to show the panel, disable click-through or quit. Expand the hidden icons arrow if Windows hides the icon. Choose Quit to stop the controller completely.
雙擊開啟主視窗 · 右鍵開啟選單: Double-click to open · Right-click for menu
需先在 OBS 輸出設定啟用重播緩衝。: REPLAY BUFFER SHOULD BE ENABLED FIRST IN THE OBS OUTPUT SETTINGS.
面板是硬體功能提示；點擊圖中的按鍵不會執行硬體動作。: This panel explains hardware mappings. Clicking its buttons does not execute hardware actions.
面板移出螢幕時按「移回目前螢幕」。按住通用鍵或切換其他功能頁時，面板會跟著顯示對: The panel removes the screen by pressing "Return the current screen". When you hold down the common key or switch other functional pages, the panel follows the display configuration.
預設每次移動 2 像素。啟用輕柔加速時，連續快速轉動才逐漸增加至 4 像素；停頓: Movement defaults to 2 pixels per step. Gentle acceleration increases this gradually to 4 pixels only during continuous fast turning. Pausing, reversing or changing direction restores the small step. Motion stops on release. The default scroll amount is 8.
預設範本尚未儲存，已保留原設定：: The default template has not been saved and the original settings have been retained:
顏色會儲存，重新開啟或搬移設定後仍會保留。浮動面板的不透明度可另外調整。: Colours will be saved and will remain after reopening or moving settings. Opacity of the floating panel can be adjusted separately.
點選左側示意圖，或在上方輸入中文名稱、硬體代碼、已設定的快捷鍵，再按「前往」。: Click on a left-hand icon or enter a Chinese name, hard-code, set shortcut above and press " Go " .
點選旋鈕可設定預設的音量或亮度動作。也可以把按鍵設為「旋鈕」類別，臨時切換旋鈕用: Click on the button to set the default volume or brightness action. You can also set the button to a "dial" type, switch the button on a temporary basis and restore it with "reset".

12 種語言均可離線使用。按鍵配置、快捷鍵與 OBS 來源名稱保持原值。: All 12 languages work offline. Button mappings, shortcuts and OBS source names stay the same.
到「語言」頁選擇介面語言，按「立即套用」。主視窗、浮動鍵盤、使用說明及系統匣選單: Choose a language on the Language page and click Apply now. The main window, floating keyboard, guide and tray menu update immediately. Your choice is retained after restarting.
按住方向鍵，再转旋鈕。: Hold a direction button and turn the dial.
